{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
clean_data = completed_only[completed_only['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = clean_data.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Find the channel with highest total revenue
highest_revenue_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue_clean'].idxmax()]

# Print results
print(channel_revenue)
print(f'Highest revenue channel: {highest_revenue_channel['channel']} with revenue: {highest_revenue_channel['revenue_clean']:.2f}')"}
